California Coast.permitCategories: Coastal Zone Conservation, Seismic Structural Integrity, Wildfire Safety

checklist.title: California Coastal Commission Clearance
checklist.description: Requires visual impact surveys, beach access review, and strict setback compliance from active cliffs.

checklist.title: Seismic Zone 4 Engineering Audit
checklist.description: Demands dynamic lateral-force calculations and deep-foundation pier anchoring due to local fault lines.

checklist.title: WUI (Wildland-Urban Interface) Code Guidance
checklist.description: Integration of non-combustible exterior finishes, Class A roofing, and a dedicated 100-foot defensible space perimeter.

checklist.title: Greywater & Septic Management Plan
checklist.description: Advanced on-site filtration system mandate to protect localized coastal marine sanctuaries.

Kyoto Basin.permitCategories: Historical Heritage Protection, Aesthetic Landscape Ordinance, Wood Structures Fire Regulation

checklist.title: Historical Timber Structure Code Compliance
checklist.description: Specialist approval required for incorporating modern moisture and fire-retardant barrier layers into traditional joinery.

checklist.title: Landscape Colors & Height Restriction (Keikan Horei)
checklist.description: Strict compliance with traditional clay tiled roof angles, maximum building levels, and organic color palettes.

checklist.title: Seismic Timber Framing Seismic Retrofitting
checklist.description: Requirement for high-tech dampers and structural core isolation without altering timber aesthetic elements.

checklist.title: Archaeological Soil Assessment Survey
checklist.description: Pre-excavation archaeological evaluation which can freeze groundwork if cultural artifact traces are located.

Amalfi Coast.permitCategories: Soprintendenza Archeologia Belle Arti e Paesaggio (Cultural Heritage Authority), Hydrogeological Risk Assessment, UNESCO Zone Codes

checklist.title: Soprintendenza Monumental Restoration Clearance
checklist.description: Full hand-crafted limestone material audit. Modification of historic arches and portals is extremely restricted.

checklist.title: Hydrogeological Safety Classification (Vincolo Idrogeologico)
checklist.description: Geotechnical rock stability certificates required for slope support structures due to high coastal landslide risk.

checklist.title: UNESCO Preservation Zone Buffer Compliance
checklist.description: Strict limit on auxiliary pathways, lighting levels, and vehicle transit during construction stages.

checklist.title: Artesian Water & Marine Drainage Permits
checklist.description: Approval needed for custom drainage and marine eco-preservation runoff pipelines.

Sonoran Desert.permitCategories: Desert Flora Conservation, Passive Solar Thermal, Ground Water Protection

checklist.title: Native Plant Protection Ordinance (NPPO)
checklist.description: Mandatory survey of adult saguaro cacti, Joshua trees, and secure relocation of restricted desert desert flora.

checklist.title: Arid Climate Heat-Sink Modeling Report
checklist.description: Thermodynamic validation of rammed-earth layers and solar heat gain performance certificates.

checklist.title: County Water Right Allocation Authorization
checklist.description: Sourcing and proof of water volume limits or dedicated on-site rainwater cistern setup clearances.

checklist.title: Dark Sky Lighting Design Audit
checklist.description: Outdoor luminous limits ensuring light is fully shielded downward to preserve dark sky status.
